title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.78
summary: Schnellere Kamera-Kaltstarts durch priorisierte Verbindungswarteschlange und videobasierte permanente Vorschauen.
changes: Prioritize recording and central preview first camera connections over slow recovery starts
Maintain concurrency bound and use age-based fairness for long-waiting camera recoveries
Avoid a redundant optional audio start attempt for permanent video-only previews
Expose queue priority and current occupancy in startup diagnostics
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.78
description: Faster, fair camera cold-start scheduling with fewer unnecessary media attempts.
releaseNotes: 2.20.78 prioritizes critical recording and initial camera preview starts above second-wave recovery, retains maximum concurrency and fairness, and removes the redundant optional audio attempt from permanent preview startup. No changes to recordings or camera configuration.
